svg.title: DPO learns directly from preference pairs
svg.desc: DPO derives a closed-form optimum for KL-regularized RLHF, inverts it into an implicit reward β log(πθ/πref), and substitutes this into Bradley–Terry preference loss. The partition term cancels, so DPO trains on offline preference pairs without a separate reward model or PPO loop.

g.text: DPO learns directly from preference pairs
The policy-to-reference log-ratio is an implicit reward; the partition term cancels.
offline preference pairs · no RL loop
The intractable β log Z(x) cancels in the preference difference.
